response.sql: WITH per_scan AS (SELECT crewref, gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans), op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_n, AVG(gb_per_min) AS op_avg FROM per_scan GROUP BY crewref HAVING AVG(gb_per_min) IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(op_avg) AS all_avg FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.scan_n) AS avg_scans, AVG(op.op_avg) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.op_avg - g.all_avg) AS avg_excess FROM op CROSS JOIN g WHERE op.op_avg > g.all_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The all-operator figure is the unweighted mean of each operator's average per-scan gbsize/spanmin (each operator counts once), not the pooled mean over all scans.
Scans with NULL gbsize or NULL/zero spanmin give a NULL ratio and are ignored in the averages; operators with no valid ratio are excluded from the all-operator average.
The scan count per operator is the total number of scans they did (COUNT(*)), including scans whose ratio is missing.

alternatives.interpretation: Scan count per operator includes only scans with a valid (non-missing) gb/min ratio.
